description: This file defines the TrackerListController class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin, responsible for preparing and attaching a Vue.js component for the performance tracker list view.

classes.name: TrackerListController
classes.description: Controller handling the performance tracker list view, extends AbstractVueController and initializes a Vue component during the pre-render phase.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating and assigning a Vue component named 'performance-tracker-list' before rendering.
